environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in the same VPC. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:regional/webacl/b2b-import-acl/a1b2c3d4) with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: Priority 1 - AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet' with all rules in default action (BLOCK), which includes the 'ExploitablePaths_URIPATH' and 'Host_localhost_HEADER' rules; Priority 2 - Custom rule 'size-constraint-body' limiting body to 8KB with BLOCK action; Priority 3 - AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with SizeRestrictions_BODY overridden to COUNT. The Web ACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the WAF is receiving and evaluating traffic. Note: The AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet includes rule 'Log4JRCE' and general bad input patterns but its XXE coverage relies on detecting DOCTYPE declarations with ENTITY/SYSTEM keywords in request bodies via the 'JavaDeserializationRCE_BODY' and related inspection rules that scan for serialization attack patterns.

config.load_balancer: ALB with WAFv2 Web ACL attached
